summary: User identified need for native Puppet Master Goal Mode because Codex Goal Mode succeeded where prompt-packet ledger transfer failed, and PM users will use multiple model providers/qualities.

Captured implementation lessons from Codex, Claude Code, Hermes, OpenClaw, OpenCode plugins, and PI goal projects: durable state, continuation scheduling, constrained tools, evaluator/judge loops, and limitations of hook/marker approaches.

Captured risk that low-quality agents may miss or hallucinate issues in massive documents; design requires runtime-owned completion, evidence/certification, role separation, and bounded worker authority.
Captured requirement that invisible internal Goal Mode must be completely hands-off except explicit user stop/constraint or true hard blockers.
User corrected earlier framing: old prompt-packet/D2 approach did not work and should not be preserved as foundation; native Goal Mode must preserve whole-task coherence.
Reviewed current repo planning substrate: standardized v2 ledgers, standardized Plan docs/PlanUnits, current Chain Wizard docs incomplete, and node compiler contract intentionally incomplete.
Captured user-facing Goal Mode UI requirements: activation button/chip, /goal, natural language activation, status indicator, tasks/todos, pause/resume/stop, goal update controls, and status menu.
Captured requirement for parent goals to spawn parallel agents/child goals with dedicated objectives and synthesize results under parent authority.
Captured Codex v0.140.0 Goal Mode attachment preservation requirement for oversized text, large pasted blocks, images, and remote app-server sessions.

Captured PMConcept assistant-chat surfaces that Goal Mode should reuse: mode dropdown, slash menu, plan/task tracker, thread pulse/summary, footer context usage, active subagent indicator, files-touched strip, message blocks, and runtime popovers.
Materialized retrospective v2 planning ledger for Native Goal Runtime and Assistant Chat Goal Mode, ready for a later explicit compile to canonical Plans.

Validated generated ledger package with `python3 scripts/pm-bootstrap-ledger-validate.py Plans/ledgers/v2/pldg-20260616-001-goal-runtime-system`; validation passed with zero errors and zero warnings. Full governance gates were not run as a package requirement because this active ledger intentionally does not update Spec Lock, evidence bundles, shards, plan_graph, auto_decisions, or other governance seal artifacts.
